thread:
maria: Need a compact design pack for the SMB launch: one-page benchmark, three paid hero sizes, a simple caching+batching diagram, two webinar slides, and a small GIF. Deadline: final exports next Mon. First drafts by Thu AM.

sam_design: I can do it. Quick spec request: exact hero sizes, export formats, and whether localization layers are needed?

maria: Sizes: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 1200x675. Export PNG @2x, SVG for diagram, PDF and PPTX for slides. Yes, separate FR/DE text layers. Keep copy short for paid ads.

jordan_pm: Brand constraints: Type Scale v2, primary palette only, AA contrast for body text. No old gradient. Provide alt text for infographic.

brandbot: Auto-check: --redwood-primary-soft fails AA for 14px. Use --redwood-secondary for microcopy or increase size. Letterspacing for headings -0.02em.

leo_marketing: Add paid variants with 15-char headline + CTA and organic variants with longer copy. I'll supply 3 short stat lines for callouts by EOD.

sam_design: Noted. Spec summary: hero tiles (PNG + fig), one-pager (PNG+PDF+fig), diagram (SVG+PNG), slides (fig+PPTX), GIF (<=500KB, 3s). Naming rdw_smbkit_<asset>_v1. Upload to s3://redwood-marketing/launch-smb/ on handoff.

ava_ops: Include a small readme.txt with usage rules and an export manifest. PPTX must include speaker notes TL;DR. Ping infra for CDN invalidation if needed.

maria: Perfect. @sam_design tag me in Figma when frames are up. Thanks! :tada:
